## 3642ceca5803

**Reproduced shortcut: the generated context does not encode the advertised
rotation sequence.**  Generator SHA-256
`79a1302891ee8d1bd5edfeb55e47a2ea32b1a05983fa05a3b66650ab4ecf6233`;
executed rule hash `b077e8996efa`.

At seed `0`, sample index `0`, default difficulty, the target validator accepts
the generated grid.  Its first three panel occupancies are not successive
90-degree clockwise rotations.  I then changed only the first two panels,
leaving the third panel byte-identical and retaining dividers and nonzero motifs;
the validator also accepts that counterfactual.  The Racket authority returns
the same output for both inputs because it reads only the third panel, rotates
its occupancy, and recolors it cyan.  Thus a learner can ignore every contextual
panel.  In a finite probe of seeds `0..63` with `sample_index = seed % 7`, exactly
`0/64` generated inputs had the first three panels form the stated rotation
sequence.  Evidence: `checks/audit/3642ceca5803/counterexample.json` and
`checks/audit/3642ceca5803/racket.json`.

The untouched battery also failed lint, defect lint, and override checking, with
profile-floor and semantic advisories; its summary is
`checks/audit/3642ceca5803/battery/checks/3642ceca5803_before_battery_summary.json`.
No audit-target fix was made.

## 3642ceca5803

**Source bound; findings only.** Audited version 1.4.0, generator SHA-256 `79a1302891ee8d1bd5edfeb55e47a2ea32b1a05983fa05a3b66650ab4ecf6233`. Canonical program SHA-256 `b077e8996efa8e6f349c33e27dea005bdb9a94ee9ad04d664872e398d9a8cfda`; public rule identifier `b077e8996efa`. The executable callable has a separate SHA-256, `42601bcee97052efa3bb916f6238f1a34aae977865151bb833300af0e09c4939`. Neither the audited source nor authority was changed.

### A36.1 — Reproduced existing context shortcut

The existing needs_triage finding from `review-38a3c9f6f591dcde:v0001` remains reproducible on the same generator bytes. At seed 0, sample index 0, default difficulty and no overrides, the first three panel motifs have 3, 3, and 2 occupied cells. They cannot be successive rotations, since rotation preserves cell count. The input passes self_check.

A retained counterfactual changes only the first two panels and preserves the third exactly. Both inputs are accepted and produce identical actual Racket outputs, matching the declared shortcut: ignore other panels, rotate the third tile clockwise, and recolor its occupancy to 8. The counterfactual fits the documented panel/motif domain; it is not claimed as a sampled draw. This revalidates an open context/teaching finding rather than claiming a newly discovered source defect or a new authority error.

Evidence: cases generated_base and context_counterfactual (input indices 0 and 1) in `checks/audit/3642ceca5803/audit-report.json`, with exact inputs and labels in `checks/audit/3642ceca5803/input.json` and `checks/audit/3642ceca5803/racket.json`.

### A36.2 — Reproduced ignored motif_size control

At seed 0, sample index 0 and default difficulty, generate(..., motif_size=1) and generate(..., motif_size=4) yield byte-identical accepted inputs with panel motif counts [3,3,2,4,2,3]. The source declares motif_size but never reads its override; it independently samples the motif count. Thus the valid setting motif_size=1 does not constrain each motif to one cell. The identical input is also input 0 in the six-input Racket batch.

Evidence: motif_control and the motif_size_1 / motif_size_4 cases in `checks/audit/3642ceca5803/audit-report.json`; the retained reproducer is `checks/audit/3642ceca5803/probe.py`.

### A36.3 — Reproduced empty third panel and blank answer

At seed **241**, sample index **3**, difficulty **easy**, and no overrides, ordinary generation emits an input of **4 rows × 19 columns**, with panel motif counts **[1,2,0,1,2]**. self_check returns an empty issue list although the advertised invariant requires a motif in each panel. The generator skips a sampled shape when it does not fit; the validator checks for motif cells only somewhere in the grid.

Actual Racket execution returns an all-zero output of **3 rows × 4 columns**. This is a concrete emitted teaching defect involving the panel actually used by the authority. The exact input is index 2 in `checks/audit/3642ceca5803/input.json`; the reference output and empty_third_witness record are in `checks/audit/3642ceca5803/racket.json` and `checks/audit/3642ceca5803/audit-report.json`.

### Exact exercised scope

All census draws use sample_index = seed % 7 and no overrides. The following is structural evidence; it does not imply 320 Racket executions.

| Structural result | Default, seeds 0..63 | Easy, seeds 0..255 |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Generated and accepted by self_check | 64/64 | 256/256 |
| First three complete tiles form clockwise rotation sequence | 0/64 | 0/256 |
| First three tightly cropped shapes form rotation sequence | 4/64 | 9/256 |
| Inputs with any empty panel | 0/64 | 10/256 |
| Inputs with empty third panel | 0/64 | 1/256 |

The cropped check removes padding and dimension effects; most examples still fail that weaker sequence condition. Fresh public apply executed six unique retained inputs: the three witnesses above and all three labelled canonical pairs. All six outputs were valid and matched the third-tile shortcut; that shortcut fits all three canonical labels. No full battery, private solve, or production lesson-identifiability claim is made. All prior findings remain open.

Command records are `checks/audit/3642ceca5803/command-03-prepare.json`, `checks/audit/3642ceca5803/command-02-apply.json`, and `checks/audit/3642ceca5803/command-04-analyze.json`. Final file/input bindings and comparisons are confirmed by `checks/audit/3642ceca5803/verification.json`. The structural draw census is `checks/audit/3642ceca5803/census.json`, and the independent shortcut predictions are `checks/audit/3642ceca5803/rival-output.json`.
